apps.name: OneRM
apps.blurb: A more refined version of Atlas
apps.description: OneRM strips the workout logger down to the calculation. Pick a lift, enter your working weight and reps, and get an estimated one-rep max with a warm-up ramp. Built with React Native and Expo, with WatermelonDB for local storage, Apple Health integration, and i18n support.

apps.name: Atlas
apps.blurb: A clean, stats-focused workout logger for iOS. Designed and built solo with React Native.
apps.description: Atlas is a workout logger built for people who care about progressive overload. It tracks lifts, computes 1RMs, and gets out of the way during a session. Built solo with React Native, Redux, and Realm.

apps.name: WSIGTE
apps.tag: Where Should I Go To Eat?
apps.blurb: Map-based restaurant roulette for indecisive groups. A tribute to wtfsigte.com.
apps.description: Tap a button, get a place. WSIGTE picks somewhere nearby for when nobody can decide. Built on Apple MapKit JS, with a Lambda backend handling auth and tokens.

apps.name: Atlas Design System
apps.blurb: A themable React Native component library with 20+ components. Powers Atlas and other apps.
apps.description: A themable design system library with core UI components for React Native. Includes buttons, text inputs, sheets, segmented controls, forms, and more. Built with TypeScript, supports light and dark themes out of the box, and is published on npm.

apps.name: ezBudget
apps.blurb: A personal budgeting app for tracking income, expenses, and recurring transactions.
apps.description: ezBudget helps you stay on top of your finances with budgets, transaction logging, and recurring expense tracking. Built with React Native and Expo, using WatermelonDB for local storage, CloudKit sync, Skia-powered charts, and Apple Sign In.
